Scope note from seat 5's contract review of PR #37484 (record 7187652688, N1). The D3 sentence must carry a per-body-state qualifier. The cursor `outlineFrom` is a position in the current body's order, so "every heading is listed on exactly one page" holds for one state of the body. If the body is edited between two page calls, the walk can skip or repeat headings with no signal, though the anchors on each page stay current. Say so in the amended D3 sentence. Also word the D4 input line so the `anchor` / `outlineFrom` exclusion is stated: the pair is refused 400 before any read.
